Installing Melange
==================

Download and extraction
-----------------------

1. Download melange-*.zip from https://github.com/JaminB/melange/releases
2. Extract it. You now have Melange.exe, melange.asi, dinput8.dll, Melange.ini and Mods\.

Setup
-----

1. Run Melange.exe. It will:
   - Locate your Worms Ultimate Mayhem folder (from Steam, GOG, or you pick it)
   - Verify the build is #1077 (the only supported version)
   - Show whether Ultimate ASI Loader (dinput8.dll) is present
   - Install or update Melange and suggest some plugins

2. Follow the setup wizard. It takes about a minute. Nothing changes until you confirm, and everything
   can be undone from the Home page.

3. Launch the game from Melange's Launch button, or start it as usual. The window title shows [Melange x.y.z].

Managing Melange
----------------

After setup, Melange's window lets you:
- Enable, disable or uninstall Melange (Settings › Melange)
- Browse and install plugins from the Store
- Configure installed plugins (Plugins page, Settings button per plugin)
- Change your default set of plugins (Settings › Defaults)
- Undo any change from a backup (Settings › Melange › Backups)

Updates
-------

Melange keeps itself up to date. Each time you open Melange.exe, it asks GitHub for the latest release.
A newer one is downloaded in the background and checked (its SHA-256, and that it is signed by the same
publisher). Then Melange shows "Melange x.y.z is ready — Restart to update". One click closes Melange,
installs the update into your game folder (with a backup, like any install) and opens the new version.
Close the game first. Settings › Updates › Check for updates looks again on demand.

The game also looks at most once a day and only tells you when a newer version is out. To turn both
off, switch off Settings › Updates › Check for updates automatically (it also sets CheckInGame=0 under
[Update] in Melange.ini); Check for updates still works. Each check is a plain HTTPS request to GitHub
that sends nothing about you or your game.

Manual install (if Melange.exe doesn't work for you)
------------------------------------------------------

1. Copy dinput8.dll, melange.asi and Melange.ini into your game folder, next to WormsMayhem.exe
   (...\steamapps\common\WormsXHD). Copy Melange.exe there too if you want it in the game folder.

2. Start the game. The window title shows [Melange x.y.z].

Installing a mod
----------------

Either:
- Run Melange.exe › Plugins › Store, find a plugin and click Install
- Or put the mod's folder in <game>\Mods\, so you have <game>\Mods\<mod>\spice.json

Then start the game and press the grave key (to the left of 1, above Tab) to open the overlay.
On the Thumper/Mods page, switch the mod on. Mods that change gameplay take effect the next
time you start the game.

The Mods\ folder in this zip has example mods, all switched off. Copy one into <game>\Mods\ to try it.

Good to know
------------

- Online play: everyone in a match needs the same gameplay mods. Mods that only change your screen,
  such as effects and UI, don't matter to other players.
- Permissions: a mod that asks for raw access to the game's memory ("Deep Desert") shows a consent
  dialog first. Only allow mods you trust.

Uninstalling
------------

Use Melange's Home page: Settings › Melange › Uninstall. Choose whether to keep your plugins, mods
and settings, or delete everything.

Or do it manually: delete melange.asi, Melange.ini and the Melange and Mods folders from the game
folder. Delete dinput8.dll too, unless other .asi mods still need it.

Reporting a bug
---------------

In the game, press Ctrl+Shift+F11 (or File > Save logs as... in the overlay) and attach the zip it saves.
Or run Melange.exe › Help › Save logs as zip when the game is closed.
User names are removed, and Steam IDs and IP addresses are hashed.
